name: io.github.soyrageagency/docker-mcp-server
description: Chat with your Docker host: inspect containers, read logs, view images, networks and volumes, report host and disk usage, and manage containers or Compose stacks — with read-only and allowlist safety.

environmentVariables.name: DOCKER_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Docker Engine endpoint. Defaults to the local socket; set it for a remote TCP/TLS daemon.

environmentVariables.name: DOCKER_MCP_READONLY
environmentVariables.description: Expose only read tools — no start/stop/restart/remove, no Compose writes.

environmentVariables.name: DOCKER_MCP_ALLOW_EXEC
environmentVariables.description: Allow running commands inside containers. Off by default.

environmentVariables.name: DOCKER_MCP_DEFAULT_LOG_TAIL
environmentVariables.description: How many log lines to return by default.
